description: An elementary substructure satisfies a given first-order theory if and only if its ambient structure does.
signature:
FirstOrder.Language.ElementarySubstructure.theory_model_iff.{u_1, u_2, u_3} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {M : Type u_1}
  [L.Structure M] (S : L.ElementarySubstructure M) (T : L.Theory) : ↥S ⊨ T ↔ M ⊨ T
